facts.text: The repository's motorized polarizer class is A8MRU in motorized_pol_v2.py, and the module loads USMCDLL.dll through ctypes
The module appends an external MicroSMC directory to sys.path and imports the USMC parameter structures from pol_rotator_p35.Mot_pol_params
The A8MRU constructor calls USMC_Init and writes the mode, parameters and start parameters it built
The initial mode sets ResetD=1 (power off and make a whole step) and disables both trailer limit switches (Tr1En and Tr2En are 0)
getCurPos converts the controller's CurPos to degrees as CurPos * (360. / 4800.)
MoveAbs divides the target position in degrees by degperstep and calls USMC_Start
MoveAbsWait polls getCurPos until the angle is within 2 degrees and has no timeout
MoveRel reads the state, adds the jog divided by degperstep, and calls USMC_Start
The vendor header documents USMC_State.CurPos as the current position in microsteps
The vendor header documents USMC_Stop as stopping the device
The vendor header documents USMC_Start as taking a destination position, a speed and the start parameters
The microscope application enables the motor with MotorOn after constructing A8MRU
